newsitem.title: USA: PETERSEN COS INC FILES FOR IPO.
newsitem.headline: PETERSEN COS INC FILES FOR IPO.

text.p: The Petersen Companies Inc, a publisher of specialty magazines, Friday registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for an initial public offering of Class A stock in the United States and overseas.
Underwriting will be led by Morgan Stanley & Co. Inc, Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, Alex Brown & Sons Inc and Goldman, Sachs & Co.
Net proceeds will be used to repay bank debt and redeem certain securities.
The company produces 78 publications such as "Motor Trend," "'Teen," "Sport," "Skin Diver," and "Motorcyclist."
